app_name: Kruger National Park - Fire & Rainfall Management DSS
changelog:
### Release 1.0.0 (Initial Open-Source Release)
- Modernized Python 3 / QGIS 3.x 64-bit GIS engine replacing legacy MapWinGIS / DotSpatial.
- Integrated Rainfall Station Manager for 21 weather stations with direct Db.mdb synchronisation.
- Dual real-time progress bars with active elapsed time monitors for long processes.
- Attorre and Navashni ecological fire impact and rainfall spatialization algorithms.
- BaseGrid 2027 extension with 2km boundary buffer eliminating perimeter gaps.
- Automatic startup loading of Kruger boundary layer (bndry_kruger.shp).
